title: District boundaries
summary: Official boundaries of Ghana's districts, used to group every result and to join on P-codes.

temporal.note: Validity date as given in the COD-AB release

method: Admin level 2 polygons loaded unchanged into PostGIS (EPSG:4326); 260 districts, 0 invalid geometries. Areas are computed geodesically.
limitations: District changes after the boundaries' validity date are not reflected.
Names can differ from common usage (for example Lower Manya for Lower Manya Krobo): always join on P-code, never on name.
